text:
Jackie’s opportunity cost when she does the taxes herself is the income she forgoes from the three freelance hours she cannot work:

\[
3\text{ hrs}\times \$35/\text{hr}= \$105.
\]

If she hires an accountant, she pays a flat fee of \$90 but can work those three hours and earn the \$105 she would otherwise miss.

The net financial gain from hiring the accountant versus doing the taxes herself is therefore

\[
\$105\;(\text{earned})-\$90\;(\text{fee}) = \$15.
\]

So hiring the accountant leaves Jackie with **\$15 more** than doing the taxes herself.

**Final answer:** 15
